Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Crypto store

Conventional payment processors like Stripe and PayPal are unreliable in countries with restricted access. In these regions, customers are left without a way to pay for digital products. COREMERCH's stacks fill this gap by providing a sovereign digital commerce infrastructure. By deploying a crypto store on Cloudflare Pages, you can accept payments directly from customers without relying on a traditional payment processor. This approach ensures that your customers can pay for your digital products, even in regions where Stripe and PayPal are blocked.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying a crypto store on Cloudflare Pages, you'll need a few essential tools and knowledge. You'll require a Cloudflare account, a GitHub account, and a basic understanding of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. You'll also need to choose a cryptocurrency that you want to accept as payment. NOWPayments, a crypto payment gateway, is integrated with all COREMERCH stacks and supports over 300 cryptocurrencies. Additionally, you'll need to have a digital product ready for sale and a plan for delivering it to customers.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Once you have all the necessary tools and knowledge, you can set up your payment and delivery pipeline. This involves creating a Cloudflare Pages site, configuring the payment gateway, and setting up a delivery mechanism for your digital product. You can also use the full source code and NOWPayments integration guide to customize your payment and delivery pipeline.

COREMERCH's stacks make it easy to go live, and the Sovereign Blueprint provides a detailed guide on how to do it.
